name: Logitech G502 HERO
notes: 67-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Logitech G502 HERO, from a libinput record of the device on Linux: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/uploads/f25d24a6f26283ae8eb597c1cf8e1159/mouse.yml. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
